information.comment: ADR-0065 D2 — role: data and figures (statistics, tables, charts, quantitative emphasis). Never actions or system states. Scope widened from ADR-0051's content-statistics restriction; PENDING BRAND-GUIDE BACK-SYNC

classification.comment: ADR-0065 D2 — role: taxonomy (discipline tags, categories, filters). Never actions or system states. Scope widened from ADR-0051's tags/sport-specialty restriction; PENDING BRAND-GUIDE BACK-SYNC

featured.comment: ADR-0051 — Role/Accent Token, restricted to editorial/heritage content only — never CTAs, forms, or generic cards/badges. Scope unchanged by ADR-0065
